interventions.detail: pip install -e needs --no-build-isolation because setup.py imports torch
python3-dev (Python.h) needed to compile C++ extensions; also ninja-build, libgl1, libglib2.0-0
Installed CPU torch/torchvision from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu and opencv-python-headless for the demo
Set FORCE_CUDA=0 and an empty CUDA_HOME so the build stays CPU-only despite the CUDA toolkit in the image
demo/demo.py imported vision.fair.detectron2.demo.predictor (internal path); changed to 'from predictor import'
demo/demo.py: create --output dir if it doesn't exist and has no extension (upstream writes <dir>.png)
